page.title: About
page.description: I build the tools other people use to make games — and I write the code and author the art, which is why the tools I build for artists actually get used.

heading: Making games and building tools to operate them
argument_html: Editor tooling, asset pipelines, developer-facing SDKs, self-service authoring tools — seven years in the industry spanning from an indie studio to a large live-ops publisher.

I feel comfortable diving into any area of game development and any existing codebase, I enjoy building tools that will be used to make better games and to provide a better experience to the people that operates them.

toolset.heading: What I work in
toolset.intro_html: My day to day tools at both professional and personal projects.

contact.heading: Let's talk
contact.body_html: Open to tools, pipeline, platform or generalist game engineer roles. Based in Mexico City.
